en-US.pack.sunny_home_garden.title: Sunny Home Garden
en-US.pack.sunny_home_garden.summary: A gentle first pack set in a small round house and its sunny garden, with Soli and Fern, four lessons, two team missions, and a goodnight routine.
en-US.character.soli.name: Soli
en-US.character.soli.line_1: What is this? Let us find out together!
en-US.character.soli.line_2: You tried it — let us sing about it!
en-US.character.soli.design_bible.silhouette: Perfect circle body with a big round head merged into one round shape, tiny legs, and two short leaf-ears on top; reads as a single circle at thumbnail size.
en-US.character.soli.design_bible.palette: Warm yellow body, coral cheeks and leaf-ears, cream belly; one warm accent family only.
en-US.character.soli.design_bible.prop: Small sun-shaped hand drum, tapped with a flat hand, never shaken near the face; the song prop.
en-US.character.soli.design_bible.movement: Bounces twice on every celebration; bright, bouncy, and curious.
en-US.character.fern.name: Fern
en-US.character.fern.line_1: Where does this go? We can look together.
en-US.character.fern.line_2: What comes next? Take your time.
en-US.character.fern.design_bible.silhouette: Tall pear or teardrop body with a long neck, long drooping leaf-ears, and long arms; reads as a tall teardrop, the opposite of Soli in height and width.
en-US.character.fern.design_bible.palette: Sage green body, cream belly, plum leaf-ears; one cool accent family only, sharing no dominant colour with Soli.
en-US.character.fern.design_bible.prop: Small soft sorting basket for lessons, and a small green watering can with a short spout for missions.
en-US.character.fern.design_bible.movement: Sways gently side to side while waiting; calm, patient, and methodical, never rushing the child.
en-US.skill.everyday_object_words.title: Everyday Object Words
en-US.skill.everyday_object_words.description: Meet and name friendly everyday objects around the sunny home garden.
en-US.skill.colour_naming.title: Colour Naming
en-US.skill.colour_naming.description: Name and match gentle colours in the Colour Garden — red, yellow, blue, and later green.
en-US.skill.sorting_one_rule.title: Sorting, One Rule
en-US.skill.sorting_one_rule.description: Sort household things into two groups with one kind rule at the tidy shed sorting basket.
en-US.skill.sequencing_now_next.title: Now and Next
en-US.skill.sequencing_now_next.description: Put two little steps in order — now first, then next — at the kitchen table and the bedtime porch.
en-US.scaffold.l0.prompt: Take a look at all the pictures and tap when you are ready.
en-US.scaffold.l1.prompt: Here are two calm choices — tap the one we noticed together.
en-US.scaffold.l2.prompt: Watch the gentle glow, then tap the glowing picture.
en-US.scaffold.l3.prompt: Let us do it together — I will point, and you make the final tap.
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.title: Hello, Cup!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_1.prompt: Soli holds up something from the kitchen shelf. Tap it to hear its name!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_1.celebration: You tapped the cup — Soli sings its name for you!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_2.prompt: Soli says “cup”! Can you tap the cup?
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_2.celebration: There it is — you found the cup!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_3.prompt: Now say it with Soli — tap the cup and say “cup”!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_3.celebration: You said the word with Soli — what a friendly hello!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_4.prompt: The cup is hiding in the garden. Can you tap it?
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_4.celebration: You found the cup in the garden!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_5.prompt: One more hello for the cup — tap it gently!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.step_5.celebration: Hello, cup! Soli bounces twice for you!
en-US.lesson.hello_cup.closing_win: We said hello to the cup together — and finished with a song!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.title: Red Flower, Yellow Flower
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_1.p: Two flowers are the same colour here. Tap the red flower!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_1.c: You matched the two red flowers!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_2.p: Soli sings “red”! Tap a flower that is red.
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_2.c: Red, red, red — you found the red flower!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_3.p: Say “red” with Soli — tap the red flower and sing it together.
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_3.c: You sang the colour name with Soli!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_4.p: One more red thing is in the garden. Tap it!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_4.c: A red ball — you found another red thing!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_5.p: Tap the red flower one more time for our colour song!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.step_5.c: Red flower, yellow flower — you named the colours!
en-US.lesson.red_flower_yellow_flower.closing_: We matched and named colours together — and finished with a song!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.title: Where Does This Go?
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_1.prompt: Fern shows two baskets. Red things go in the red basket — tap the red basket!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_2.prompt: Fern puts the first one in. Now you tap something red!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_2.celebra: The red ball goes in — red things together!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_3.prompt: Your turn to sort. Tap something red!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_3.celebra: The red sock joins the red group!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_4.prompt: Two things left. Tap something yellow!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_4.celebra: The yellow book goes in the yellow group!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_5.prompt: The baskets are full! Tap a basket to name the groups together.
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.step_5.celebra: Red things and yellow things — two tidy groups!
en-US.lesson.where_does_this_go.closing_win: We sorted with one kind rule together — and finished with a song!
en-US.lesson.now_next.title: Now, Next!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_1.prompt: Two cards are mixed up. Tap them to look together!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_1.celebration: We looked at both cards together!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_2.prompt: Which card is for now? Tap the Now card!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_2.celebration: Now comes first — we tidy now!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_3.prompt: Which card comes after now? Tap the Next card!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_3.celebration: Next comes after now — we sing next!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_4.prompt: Watch Soli and Fern act it out — tap the Now card as they tidy!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_4.celebration: Now, then next — they showed the whole little routine!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_5.prompt: Tap the Next card to act it out with them!
en-US.lesson.now_next.step_5.celebration: Now and next — you put the day in order!
en-US.lesson.now_next.closing_win: We put two little steps in order — now, then next — and finished with a goodnight song!

en-US.mission.tidy_team.title: Tidy Team
en-US.mission.tidy_team.parent_script: Put the device down. Together with your child, choose one rule — colours first, or kinds on another day. Take turns: your child puts one thing in, you put one thing in, until six things sit in two groups. Name the two groups together out loud.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.child_prompt: Let us put our things away in two groups together.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.team_goal: Sort six friendly things into two groups as a team.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.precheck: Please confirm the floor is clear, the items are large and soft with no small parts, and a grown-up stays beside your child throughout.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.return_ritual: We did it together — Soli and Fern hum your song fragment with you.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.safety_1: Check the floor for small objects before you begin.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.safety_2: No climbing to reach high shelves — keep everything at child height.
en-US.mission.tidy_team.safety_3: If anything breaks or spills, stop and clean up together, celebrating the help.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.title: Table Helpers
en-US.mission.table_helpers.parent_script: Put the device down. Together with your child, set out a simple table for a snack or meal a grown-up has already prepared. Now: napkins down together. Next: plates and cups down together. Name “Now, Next, done!” together.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.child_prompt: Let us set our table together, one light thing at a time.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.team_goal: Set a simple table together for a snack a grown-up has already prepared.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.precheck: Please confirm there is no glass, no knives, and no hot items on the table yet, and a grown-up stays beside your child throughout.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.return_ritual: Now, next, done — we did it together! Soli and Fern hum your goodnight song fragment with you.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_1: A grown-up places anything heavy, hot, or breakable.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_2: Your child carries one light, unbreakable item at a time.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_3: Dry wet hands before carrying anything.
en-US.mission.table_helpers.safety_4: You can stop anytime and still celebrate together.
en-US.mission.water_plants.title: Watering Team
en-US.mission.water_plants.parent_script: Put the device down. With a small, grown-up-filled vessel, care for a plant together: now a little drink, next a gentle wipe of the leaves. Use the highest level your home has — a small cup, a small watering can, or a damp cloth.
en-US.mission.water_plants.child_prompt: Let us give our plant a small drink together.
en-US.mission.water_plants.team_goal: Care for a plant together with a small drink and a gentle wipe.
en-US.mission.water_plants.precheck: Please confirm the plant is safe — not toxic, not spiky, within reach without climbing — any water is a small grown-up-filled amount, and a grown-up stays beside your child throughout.
en-US.mission.water_plants.return_ritual: The plant had its drink — we did it together! Soli and Fern hum your song fragment with you.
en-US.mission.water_plants.safety_1: A grown-up checks the plant is not toxic or spiky first.
en-US.mission.water_plants.safety_2: No tasting soil — watering is for the plant only.
en-US.mission.water_plants.safety_3: Wipe spills immediately and keep water away from sockets and devices.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.title: Goodnight Garden
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.parent_script: A calm, parent-led wind-down. On the device: Fern shows three picture cards and sings the first line of the goodnight song. Then put the device down — the routine does not need the screen after the start.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.child_prompt: Let us get ready for bed together, one kind step at a time.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.team_goal: Wind down for bed together: tidy one thing, share a quiet book or song, and dim the lights.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.return_ritual: You came back! Soli and Fern sing your song fragment together to welcome you.
en-US.routine.goodnight_garden.safety_1: Keep the lights low and soft for the last step, and an adult stays with the child until they are settled.
en-US.time_concept.now_next.title: Now and Next
en-US.time_concept.now_next.prompt: First we tidy now, and next we sing together.
